description: Veteran's Battlegear Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest. Requirements: - Cenarion Combat Badge x 7 - Cenarion Logistics Badge x 4 - Cenarion Tactical Badge x 4 - Cenarion Circle:
